# ferriskey_organization_attribute (Resource)

Manages a single key/value attribute on an organization. Setting the same key again overwrites the value; destroying the resource deletes the attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_organization_attribute" "tier" {
  realm           = "acme"
  organization_id = ferriskey_organization.tenant.organization_uuid
  key             = "tier"
  value           = "gold"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Attribute key. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `realm` (String) Realm the organization belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `value` (String) Attribute value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{organization_id}/{key}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_organization_attribute.tier acme/ORG_UUID/tier
```
